author: Houston Republic
title: Tom Oliverson voices opposition to current physician ownership laws in recent social media posts
text:
Tom Oliverson, M.D., a Republican member of the Texas State House representing the 130th district since 2017, has recently expressed concerns on social media regarding legislative efforts impacting doctors and hospital ownership.
On May 6, 2026, Oliverson criticized the legislative process in a post stating, “And yet, legislators are constantly lobbied to pass legislation that hurts doctors while simultaneously turning a blind eye to the rest of it. And when we do pass something meaningful to protect doctors and patients, some knuckleheads respond by trying to pass legislation to https://t.co/oHoMLuvDQR” .
Later that day, he addressed conflicts of interest related to hospital employment and physician ownership: “It is impossible that there is less conflict of interest for a hospital to employ a doctor than for a doctor to own a hospital. It is past time to undo this nonsensical ban of physician ownership. https://t.co/SshhP5MOvV” (May 6, 2026).
In another statement posted on May 6, Oliverson called for stronger action: “Anything short of a full on ban of this is just a waste of time. https://t.co/lOkglrKDx5” .
Oliverson has served in the Texas State House since his election in 2017, succeeding Allen Fletcher as representative for District 130.
